brief: Review the open defect register for Granite Works 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-765) before the forecast heat event, and re-prioritise any outstanding work against its effect on the unit's ability to shed heat as governed by SOP-016. If vegetation or obstruction defects are outstanding, execute clearance work as it takes precedence over other remedial activity in accordance with SOP-011. Additionally, apply loading and de-rating rules as specified in MG-021 where ambient conditions or cooling limitations require it.
